paragraphs: So it is cited in the Or Zarua: Megillah 21b.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman says the name is cited thus in Or Zarua, with Megillah21b as the supplied locator. An earlier review reported no matching name in Davidson Megillah21b but attached no matching scalar. That negative observation remains a historical review claim, not fresh verification of the folio, Or Zarua or printed text.
